ابتليتن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَلَيْتُنَّ (ibtalaytunna) /ib.ta.laj.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
# اُبْتُلِيتُنَّ (ubtulītunna) /ub.tu.liː.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَلَى (ibtalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
